description: This file defines a single exported function 'shapeAgentGroupedSeries' that processes an array of records to produce a dataset suitable for visualization with Recharts. It groups data by agent and a secondary dimension ('environment' or 'cost_category'), filling in missing categories with zeros to ensure consistent grouping across agents.

methods.name: shapeAgentGroupedSeries
methods.description: Transforms raw aggregate records into a grouped dataset for visualization, with options for sorting and labeling.
